subject: math
description: Apply cylinder volume to real containers such as cans, tanks, and tubes, then interpret capacity answers with correct units and reasonableness checks.
learningObjectives: Identify the radius, diameter, and height needed in cylinder word problems
Use V = pi r squared h to find the volume of cylindrical containers
Convert cubic centimeters to milliliters and liters when interpreting capacity
Check whether a cylinder volume answer is reasonable for the situation
prerequisites: Identify radius, diameter, height, and circular base of a cylinder
Find the area of a circle using A = pi r squared
Convert 1000 cubic centimeters to 1 liter and 1 cubic centimeter to 1 milliliter
